summary: Independent verification of 4 iter12 security/correctness fixes. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_fixes_iter12.py (23 tests) covering FIX 1 product/referral/brand validation, FIX 2 oversell guard, FIX 3 password rules, FIX 4 email HTML escaping. All 23 iter12 tests PASS. Existing regression suites (test_split_regression.py + test_fixes_iter11.py) also PASS 49/49. Normal product create+update+delete lifecycle by testbrand verified working end-to-end.

fixes_verified.FIX_1_input_validation: PASS — POST /api/products: price=-5 → 422, price='abc' → 422, stock=-1 → 422, gender='alien' → 422, name<2 → 422, description<10 → 422, sizes=[] → 422, images=[] → 422, condition='bogus' → 422. Valid payload → 200. PUT /api/products/{id}: {price:-10} → 422, {price:'abc'} → 422, owner {price:49.99} → 200 (persistence verified via GET), different-brand PUT → 403. POST /api/referral/apply {'code':'ab'} → 422. PUT /api/brands/profile description 3001 chars → 422.
fixes_verified.FIX_2_oversell_guard: PASS — Function-level test on settle_paid_order: inserted throwaway product with stock=1 + two fake initiated orders. First settle → status='paid', stock=0, no oversold flag. Second settle → returned True, order flagged oversold=True, product stock stayed at 0 (never negative), brand notification of type 'oversold_order' with correct metadata.order_id created. GET /api/admin/stats returns oversold_orders as an int and >=1 during the test. All throwaway products/orders/notifications cleaned up in teardown.
fixes_verified.FIX_3_password_rules: PASS — POST /api/auth/register password='abc' → 422. Fresh email + password='longenough1' → 200. Inserted valid reset token via routes.auth._hash_reset_token() with 1h expiry. POST /api/auth/reset-password new_password='short' → 400 with detail matching 'Password must be 8' + '128 characters' (accepts both en-dash and hyphen). new_password='newvalidpass1' → 200. Test user + tokens cleaned up.
fixes_verified.FIX_4_html_escaping: PASS — Monkey-patched resend.Emails.send to capture params (no real emails sent). (a) send_order_receipt_email with product_name 'Test' and brand_name '' → captured HTML contained '<b>Test</b>' and '<script>evil</script>', and did NOT contain raw 'evil'. (b) send_order_shipped_email with malicious product_name + courier 'Alert' + message '' → escaped in captured HTML. (d) Normal strings 'Signature Hoodie' / 'Thread & Bone' / 'Size L' pass through unchanged (with '&' → '&' as expected).
fixes_verified.REGRESSION_49_tests: PASS — 43/43 test_split_regression.py + 6/6 test_fixes_iter11.py green in 13.22s. Product lifecycle (create → update → delete) by testbrand also green in TestFix1ProductValidation::test_full_lifecycle_delete.

critical_code_review_comments: Rate limiting on /api/auth/login (10/min) causes 429s if the full 3-suite run is executed in one shot (>10 logins per minute). Each suite passes independently; consider caching session cookies per email at module scope to reduce login calls, or bump the limiter for tests. Not a product bug.

settle_paid_order: oversell guard is correctly placed AFTER the atomic order-claim step, so the buyer's payment is honoured (never left in 'initiated') even when stock is exhausted — good design, matches the spec.
ProductUpdate: uses exclude_unset which is required to preserve unspecified fields — verified via price-only PUT (name/description untouched).
esc() in core: uses html.escape(str(value)) — will escape None as empty string, which prevents literal 'None' bleeding into emails. Nice defensive default.
Reset-password error uses the en-dash character (8–128), which is fine but slightly harder to grep for; test tolerates both forms.

success_rate.backend: 100% (49 iter11 regression + 23 iter12 fixes = 72/72 across the two-suite split)
